title: Analista de Laboratório de Durabilidade (Chassis)
description:
A GESTAMP é uma multinacional espanhola dedicada ao design, desenvolvimento e fabricação de componentes metálicos automotivos. Trabalhamos para servir com excelência nossos clientes e sociedade, com veículos cada vez mais eficientes e seguros, e buscamos talentos que compartilhem da mesma visão e ambição.

Somos inclusivos, aqui todas as pessoas são bem-vindas.

ANALISTA DE LABORATÓRIO DE DURABILIDADE – CHASSIS

Resumo das atividades:

  • Executar montagens mecânicas de precisão utilizando ferramentas manuais e instrumentos de medição, conforme normas técnicas e especificações de ensaio.
  • Realizar ensaios estáticos e de fadiga com equipamentos servo-hidráulicos e eletromecânicos, operados por software dedicado.
  • Efetuar inspeções visuais (ensaios não destrutivos) em ciclos pré-definidos, registrando todas as informações de forma completa e rastreável, incluindo evidências fotográficas, especialmente em casos de falhas.
  • Apoiar equipes internas e externas de manutenção (hidráulica, elétrica/eletrônica e mecânica), garantindo a confiabilidade dos sistemas de teste.
  • Interagir com fornecedores para reparo e fabricação de dispositivos de teste, incluindo solicitações de orçamento/cotação.
  • Realizar manutenções corretivas simples e ajustes mecânicos em dispositivos de ensaio conforme necessidade.
  • Desenvolver programas de ensaio de fadiga, durabilidade e estáticos nos sistemas MTS FlexTest, Lynx e Sincotec.
  • Analisar resultados de testes com ferramentas estatísticas (Weibull e Wöhler) para avaliação de confiabilidade e vida útil.
  • Elaborar instruções técnicas de ensaio para o Laboratório de Durabilidade.
  • Acompanhar ensaios realizados por fornecedores externos, quando necessário.
  • Consolidar dados em macro-relatórios técnicos para monitoramento do desempenho dos produtos ao longo do ciclo de vida dos projetos.

Requisitos obrigatórios:

- Conhecimentos avançados em Montagem Mecânica (de precisão).

- Conhecimentos avançados em Hidráulica.

- Manuseio de Instrumentos de Medição e Ferramentas Manuais.

- Conhecimentos Básicos em Elétrica/Eletrônica.

- Conhecimentos intermediário no Pacote Office.

- Inglês básico – intermediário (para leitura de normas e elaboração de relatórios)

- Experiência em Laboratório de Testes de Chassis ou ensaios mecânicos (Durabilidade/Fadiga/Ensaio de Força).

Requisitos Desejáveis:

- Treinamento para utilização de softwares de controle de teste (MTS, Lynx, Catman Easy).

- Certificação de Ensaios Não-Destrutivos Líquido Penetrante Nível 2 (Instituição: ABEND "Associação Brasileira e Ensaios Não-Destrutivos").

title: QA & RA Specialist (100 % workload)
description:
Work place: Sao Paulo, Brazil

QA & RA Specialist (100 % workload)

About Selectchemie AG

Selectchemie is an independent Swiss company serving the pharmaceutical and nutrition industry since 1969 as a premier supplier of high quality ingredients and generic finished dosage forms. As a full service provider we create added value by offering comprehensive technical, scientific, regulatory and commercial support all along the value chain. Worldwide, our 120 experienced professionals with commercial and scientific background, based at the headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland and locations in 18 countries, provide customers, principals and suppliers with solutions tailored to their needs.

Join our Pharma LATAM team

We offer a broad product portfolio of APIs & excipients and are an established hub for customers sourcing high-quality bulk raw material as well as for renowned manufacturers who benefit from our broad customer base in various markets. We are continuously expanding our global network as well as our services. We are seeking a QA & RA Associate to support our Pharma LATAM sales team in achieving their regulatory and quality assurance objectives, with focus on Brazilian and Mexican markets. This role involves close collaboration with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure compliance with ANVISA and other relevant regulations. The ideal candidate will have a strong regulatory mindset, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills.

Your tasks and responsibilities

ANVISA Submissions & API/Excipients Registration

  • Prepare, submit, and manage ANVISA dossiers from our partners and of our ownership for API and excipient registrations, renewals, variations, and amendments, in accordance with RDC 359/2022 and RDC 361/2022, which require registration of APIs used in distribution and manufacturing in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with ANVISA regulatory guidelines, monitor updates to regulatory frameworks, and implement required modifications proactively.
  • Be designated as an authorized user in order to act on behalf of the suppliers for CADIFA application.

Life Cycle Management (LCM)

  • Carry out lifecycle maintenance activities, including annual renewals, post-approval changes, and variations for APIs registrations – CADIFA under established procedures
  • Conduct gap analysis for regulatory documents and gather necessary supporting documentation from suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Regulatory Intelligence & Compliance

  • Monitor evolving Brazilian regulatory requirements and advise stakeholders accordingly.
  • Support internal teams—such as Quality, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial—by providing up-to-date regulatory guidance for API/excipient registration, import, storage, and distribution compliance.

Client & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide regulatory support and guidance to internal clients (e.g., sales, procurement) and external clients (e.g., manufacturers or exporters of APIs/excipients) regarding registration strategy, timelines, and documentation requirements.
  • Assist during ANVISA inspections, inquiries, or audits, and support resolution of any regulatory issues by preparing requested documentation and supporting senior colleagues.

Documentation & Submission Management

  • Assemble submission packages with precision—compiling documentation, certificates (e.g., GMP, certificates of analysis), product specifications, technical data, and translations where necessary.
  • Maintain regulatory dossier documentation in tracked systems to ensure completeness and ease of retrieval.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with commercial, quality assurance, procurement, and legal teams to align on regulatory deliverables and prioritize registration activities.
  • Share documentation with regional/global RA teams for alignment.

Process Enhancement & SOP Development

  • Follow existing SOPs related to APIs/excipients registration, dossier submission, product renewal, and regulatory intelligence and provide feedback on potential improvements
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to optimize submission workflows and compliance robustness.

Training & Regulatory Advocacy

  • Educate relevant internal teams (e.g. sales, imports) on regulatory implications—for example, registration deadlines, documentation requirements, handling of restricted substances—to ensure regulatory awareness throughout the organization.
  • When relevant, participate in trade associations or regulatory working groups to stay informed and potentially influence ANVISA’s regulatory environment.

Your profile

  • Education: Degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance, preferably in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of ANVISA regulations, GMP, and regulatory processes.
  • Skills: Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Communication: Ability to effectively interact with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus.

What’s in for you?

  • Entrepreneurial position in a dynamic globally acting team
  • Your input is key and you’re part of creating our future success
  • Close cooperation with colleagues across the entire hierarchy within Selectchemie
  • Short decision processes
  • Attractive compensation package and hybrid working

We are pleased to receive your complete application via:

title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization
  • Back-End Integration : Build APIs, microservices, and orchestration frameworks that seamlessly connect AI models with enterprise systems and grid-level data flows
  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production
  • Strong grounding in cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, Azure)
  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

title: Business Analyst
description:
Business Analyst – Liora Energia

Sobre a Liora

No Brasil, a maioria das pessoas ainda não sabe que pode escolher sua energia. E, quando sabe, muitas vezes não entende ou não confia em quem oferece. Nós existimos para mudar isso.

A Liora nasceu com uma missão ousada e urgente: tornar energia limpa acessível e universal. Queremos transformar um setor historicamente complicado, cheio de jargões e burocracias, em algo simples, confiável e próximo das pessoas.

Acreditamos que o futuro da energia precisa ser mais barato, mais inteligente e mais eficiente. Para chegar lá, usamos tecnologia para criar produtos que encantam, aumentar a eficiência dos nossos clientes e redesenhar a forma como a energia é consumida no Brasil.

E como vamos alcançar essa visão? Sendo a maior provedora de serviços de energia do país, com tecnologia de ponta, uma experiência que surpreende e um ecossistema de parceiros que acreditam nessa mesma causa.

Desafio

Você será responsável por construir e cuidar da experiência do cliente, garantindo que em toda a sua jornada, do primeiro contato à ativação e até a saída, aconteça de forma simples, transparente e construindo uma relação de confiança duradoura. Você será o guardião da experiência do cliente.

Seus desafios são

  • Estar na arena todos os dias: colocar a mão na massa, conversar com clientes, entender suas dores reais e transformar essas interações em aprendizados e mudanças, atuando junto com todas as áreas da empresa.
  • Trazer novos clientes para a Liora, ajudando famílias e empresas a comecem a consumir energia limpa e mais barata.
  • Construir e executar a máquina de vendas e atendimento, desenhando processos e automações que sustentem um crescimento eficiente e escalável sem perder o foco no cliente.
  • Criar uma operação AI first, onde a inteligência artificial acelera testes, gera insights em tempo real e transforma aprendizados em processos personalizados, sustentáveis e escaláveis.

Você vai estar na linha de frente com o cliente, ouvindo, testando, aprendendo, errando e construindo de novo. É isso que faz a diferença. É isso que faz a gente vencer. Aqui, você não fica na arquibancada: está na arena, ajudando a redefinir como o Brasil consome energia limpa e acessível.

Perfil que buscamos

Estamos procurando preferencialmente alguém com 1–3 anos de formado, que queira acelerar rápido, assumir responsabilidades de verdade e aprender todos os dias.

Não precisa ter experiência, o que importa é curiosidade, vontade de aprender, disciplina para executar e coragem de estar na arena conversando com clientes e ajudando a construir algo do zero.

Buscamos uma pessoa empreendedora, que gosta de autonomia, que não se limita à descrição de cargo e que sabe ouvir de verdade para transformar a dor do cliente em solução. E, acima de tudo, alguém que queira deixar sua marca em um dos maiores mercados do país e fazer parte da transição para um futuro mais sustentável.

title: Product Research Specialist (R&D)
description:
Position Summary:

The Product Research Specialist plays a key role in bridging the gap between market needs, user expectations, and internal product development. This position is responsible for leading research initiatives, analyzing user behavior, and generating insights that drive innovation, enhance product quality, and improve customer satisfaction across the Latin American market.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct in-depth market research and product benchmarking to identify trends, user preferences, and competitive positioning.

  • Prepare comprehensive field reports to support strategic decisions in product development and market positioning.
  • Research and define target user groups, identify key market opportunities, and map user needs across regions.
  • Propose actionable recommendations and support their implementation in product planning and innovation processes.
  • Lead the validation of product concepts by conducting user visits and field analysis, generating optimization proposals to improve functionality and user experience.
  • Monitor product performance in the field and provide feedback to engineering and manufacturing teams for continuous improvement.
  • Promote ongoing optimization of product quality and cost, ensuring reliability, market competitiveness, and user satisfaction.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Engineering, After-Sales, and Manufacturing to ensure product alignment with market demands.
  • Consolidate research findings into management reports and presentations, supporting strategic planning and portfolio decisions.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Product Design, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Experience in product research, market intelligence, or user experience analysis.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.
  • Experience with both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional and multicultural teams.
  • Proficiency in tools such as Excel, Power BI, or data visualization platforms.
  • Fluency in English required; Spanish is a strong plus.

title: Chatbot Developer Pleno
description:
Unidade de Negócio: Gringo & Zapay

Objetivos do cargo que você irá atuar: Responsável por desenvolver e manter chatbots em diferentes plataformas, com foco em JavaScript e Python.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Manutenção Multi-Plataforma: Atuar na sustentação, troubleshooting e correção de bugs de chatbots desenvolvidos e implantados nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Evolução Rasa: Manter e evoluir a estrutura do framework Rasa, incluindo as custom actions, o deploy e, principalmente, os pipelines de NLU e as stories complexas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura Rasa: Gerenciar e manter o ambiente de deploy do bot em Rasa, garantindo o bom funcionamento e a estabilidade.
  • Integrações: Utilizar integrações de back-end (APIs, Webhooks) para o funcionamento dos fluxos em ambas as plataformas.
  • Qualidade Conversacional e Métricas: Trabalhar com a curadoria, refinando modelos de NLP/NLU. Além disso, definir e monitorar métricas de performance conversacional (ex: Intent Accuracy , Fallback Rate , Tempo de Resposta), propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Código e Padrões: Escrever e manter código limpo, testável e bem documentado, especialmente nas custom actions do Rasa (Python) e nos scripts do BLiP (JavaScript/ Node.js ).
  • Versionamento e CI/CD: Garantir o controle de versão com Git e auxiliar na manutenção de pipelines de CI/CD para automação do deploy do bot.
  • Documentação: Manter a documentação técnica da arquitetura, integrações e procedimentos de manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

É imprescindível que você tenha:

  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e, principalmente, na sustentação (manutenção) de chatbots nas plataformas BLiP e Rasa.
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento em Python e JavaScript/ Node.js.
  • Domínio na utilização (consumo) de APIs REST/RESTful e Webhooks.
  • Conhecimento em NLP/NLU (treinamento, curadoria e fine-tuning de Intents e Entities).
  • Experiência com Git e familiaridade com conceitos de CI/CD.
  • Conhecimento e experiência prática com Docker.
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL).
  • Resolução de Problemas (Troubleshooting): Capacidade analítica para identificar, diagnosticar e resolver problemas técnicos complexos em produção de forma eficaz.
  • Metodologias Ágeis: Vivência em Scrum e/ou Kanban.

Não obrigatório, mas será incrível se você tiver:

  • Experiência com curadoria de dados conversacionais e otimização do dataset de treinamento.
  • Domínio na criação de APIs REST/RESTful do zero.
  • Conhecimento e experiência com bancos de dados NoSQL (ex: MongoDB, Redis) para armazenamento de contexto e dados conversacionais.
  • Familiaridade com orquestração de containers (ex: Kubernetes) para deploy de Rasa em escala.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering e integração de Modelos de Linguagem (LLMs) em fluxos de chatbot.
  • Familiaridade com plataformas cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) para hospedagem de serviços de apoio.

Informações adicionais

Fique por dentro do que te oferecemos:

  • Assistência Médica (SulAmérica)

title: PMO Sênior # 980247'
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Nosso Cliente

Procuramos por PMO para gerenciar e liderar o roadmap de desenvolvimento de soluções tecnológicas que suportarão projetos de dados, garantindo a orquestração entre squads, stakeholders e áreas de negócio, com foco em governança, arquitetura, engenharia e produtos de dados.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Liderança e referência da visão do cliente/negócio, desenvolver o relacionamento com clientes internos e estar pronto para ajudar no desenvolvimento do time;
  • Business-driven, conhecer o dia a dia de áreas de negócio e operações, trabalhando as principais métricas processos e necessidades. Pensar no que o negócio precisa para atingir suas metas e atender o cliente;
  • Disseminar conhecimento com seus pares, documentando, comunicando e viabilizando o acesso às informações;
  • Ter atitude de dono, buscando as melhores práticas na implementação de demandas, processos e tecnologias com foco nos resultados e entregas;
  • Comunicação assertiva e clara, sendo capaz de ser a interface com os principais stakeholders de várias áreas de negócio. Identificar, definir e gerenciar escopos de necessidades de curto, médio e longo prazos;
  • Bom raciocínio lógico, senso crítico, organização e agilidade na resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade, foco e boa capacidade de trabalhar em equipe;
  • Gerenciar projetos e programas relacionados a dados, com múltiplas squads envolvidas e escopo técnico/funcional complexo;
  • Construir e manter planos macro e detalhados de entregas (roadmap, cronograma, marcos), promovendo previsibilidade;
  • Garantir business readiness ao coordenar ações de comunicação, treinamento, documentação e alinhamento com áreas de negócio;
  • Facilitar cerimônias e processos ágeis, como Sprint Planning, Reviews e Retrospectives, quando aplicável ao projeto;
  • Orquestrar dependências técnicas e operacionais, atuando com engenharia de dados, produtos, arquitetura e governança;
  • Estabelecer rituais e cadências de comunicação com stakeholders internos e externos, reportando indicadores e progresso;
  • Inglês (projetos com stakeholders internacionais);
  • Organizar entregáveis finais, como kits de go-live, guias operacionais, planos de suporte e trilhas de capacitação.

O que você precisa ter

  • Roadmap integrado com priorizações, desdobramentos e marcos;
  • Plano de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders (matriz RACI, mapeamento de impacto);
  • Métricas de sucesso do projeto e controle de entregas por squad ou frente;
  • Cronograma de capacitação e readiness (documentação, UAT, suporte de pós-go live);
  • Acompanhamento estruturado por metodologia híbrida (ágil + tradicional);
  • Inglês Intermediário ou Avançado;
  • Planejamento e execução de Sprint 0 e fases Discovery, se aplicável.

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

Regime de Contratação

CLT.

Conhecimentos desejáveis:

  • Governança de dados (DAMA, LGPD, catálogos, data quality, linhagem);
  • Ferramentas de visualização: Power BI, Looker, Tableau, Metabase;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos: Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project;
  • Metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e tradicionais (PMBOK, PRINCE2);
  • Conhecimento em produtos de dados, data mesh e arquiteturas modernas (data lake, cloud, event-driven);
  • Storytelling com dados: saber transformar indicadores e métricas em narrativas acionáveis;
  • Espanhol é um diferencial.

title: Supervisor de suporte
description:
Supervisor(a) de Suporte | CLT | Remoto

Somos a Control iD, empresa que faz parte do grupo sueco ASSA ABLOY. Nascemos em 2006 com a missão de popularizar a biometria no Brasil. Hoje, somos líderes neste segmento e temos em nosso portfólio equipamentos e softwares de controle de acesso, automação comercial e gestão de ponto.

Resumo da vaga : O Supervisor tem vasta experiencia em sua área e domina tecnicamente os produtos da empresa. Deve estar estudando ou ser formado em áreas de gestão e ter um bom relacionamento com todos da equipe.

Atividades:

  • Garantir eficiência operacional da equipe - Assegurar que todas as demandas sejam atendidas dentro dos prazos e com qualidade, supervisionando processos, e-mails e atendimentos ao cliente.
  • Atuar como elo entre equipe, gerência e engenharia - Levar feedbacks técnicos e operacionais, alinhar estratégias com a gerência e garantir que as necessidades da equipe cheguem até a engenharia.
  • Desenvolver e capacitar a equipe - Realizar treinamentos, manter a base de conhecimento atualizada, fornecer feedbacks técnicos e apoiar o crescimento profissional dos analistas.
  • Suporte técnico avançado e relacionamento com clientes - Apoiar na resolução de casos complexos, atender clientes críticos quando necessário e garantir a satisfação em situações escalonadas.
  • Gestão de pessoas e processos de RH (em conjunto com a gerência) - Participar de entrevistas, admissões, desligamentos, avaliações de desempenho e manter bom relacionamento com todos, promovendo engajamento e alinhamento da equipe.

Para isso, é necessário que você tenha:

  • Formação acadêmica em áreas técnicas, como Engenharia, TI, Ciência da Computação, etc.

Modelo de trabalho home office, com atuação de segunda à sexta-feira em horário comercial e eventuais idas ao escritório (Zona Oeste de SP capital).

title: Coordenador de Qualidade e Cadastro
description:
Somos uma empresa completa que oferece soluções financeiras para todo ecossistema de combustível, através de: Conta Digital PF, Conta Digital PJ, Corretora de Seguros, Cartão Benefícios, Cartão de Crédito, Clube de Vantagens, Folha de Pagamento, Cobrança, Asset, FIDC, entre outros. Nossa missão é ser a principal fonte de soluções financeiras eficientes para postos de combustível, refinarias, distribuição e transportadoras de combustível, seus colaboradores e clientes.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições:

Gestão da Qualidade:

  • Coordenar e implementar o Sistema de Gestão da Qualidade (SGQ) da empresa, buscando melhoria contínua.
  • Realizar auditorias internas e externas para verificar a conformidade com os padrões estabelecidos e as normas aplicáveis (ISO, etc.).
  • Monitorar e gerenciar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs), não conformidades e ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e aprovar documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais padrão (POPs).
  • Promover a conscientização e o engajamento das equipes na busca por soluções para problemas de qualidade.

Gestão do Cadastro:

  • Desenvolver e manter a estrutura e os procedimentos para o cadastro e atualização de dados, informações, produtos ou fornecedores relevantes para a qualidade.
  • Garantir a integridade e a organização dos dados cadastrais, assegurando que sejam utilizados para suportar as decisões e o controle da qualidade.
  • Coordenar a criação e a manutenção de listas de verificação e outros documentos que utilizam os dados cadastrais para controle de processos.

Liderança e Desenvolvimento:

  • Liderar equipes de qualidade, orientando o trabalho diário e desenvolvendo as competências dos colaboradores.
  • Atuar como ponte entre a equipe e a gestão, comunicando as necessidades e os resultados dos processos de qualidade.
  • Colaborar com outras áreas para integrar as práticas de qualidade e garantir a conformidade em todas as etapas.

Qualificações Essenciais

  • Formação superior em áreas como Engenharia de Produção, Administração, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas afins.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em normas de qualidade, como ISO 9001.
  • Experiência em mapeamento de processos e implementação de SGQ.
  • Habilidade em análise de dados, elaboração de relatórios e condução de auditorias.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, liderança e relacionamento interpessoal.

Nossa escala é presencial de segunda a sexta das 08h às 17h48 na região da Henrique Schaumann próximo ao metrô Oscar Freire

title: Senior Quality Specialist, Brazil, 12-month contract
description:
Type of Role: 12 months Contract position

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil

Department: GDP Operational Area Quality

Looking for opportunities with purpose, impact and possibilities? Our client, Vertex, is a global biotechnology company that invests in scientific innovation. As they grow their pipeline at pace, they are strengthening their reputation for creating transformative medicines for people with serious diseases.

General Summary:

The Senior Quality Specialist (Contractor) role supports Market Quality and is recognized as an expert internally in the principles and application of quality assurance and compliance.

This role supports GDP operations for all distribution activities within the global distribution network; key stakeholders include Operations QA, International Supply Chain, logistics, Geographic expansion in particular support to LATAM market quality, QMS QA, Vendor Management & AIM QA.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Take ownership and provide support on QMS processes (Deviations, CAPA & Change Controls) including Root Cause Analysis, Risk Assessment, Action completion, and timely closure of records.
  • Support the intake, triage, and logging of deviations & distribution complaints into the Veeva electronic Quality Management System (VeeQMS).
  • Liaise with relevant stakeholders to obtain full information to initiate investigation and root cause analysis as per Vertex procedures. Track completion and closure in a timely manner.
  • Prepare materials for distributor sites to monitor performance on deviations, cascade information and follow up on outstanding items.
  • Support LATAM MQ team with distributor meetings and related support –
  • Including distributors KPIs and follow up and close out of action items
  • Creating list of actions for both external action items (distributors)
  • Veeva actions and related follow ups to close actions on time
  • Support MQ with SOP processing through Veeva
  • Follow up actions linked to distributor gap assessment
  • Raise risks/issues with timelines and seek support in timely resolution.
  • Support change control records as required and complete any quality actions assigned.
  • Prepare relevant QMS data reports/KPIs on Deviations, CAPA, Change Controls and Effectiveness checks, for Affiliate QMRs, inspections, ad hoc data requests and other governance meetings.
  • Support creation of, and update to, Quality Agreements with Vertex Affiliates and external vendors by; drafting using global templates, collation and amendment based on review comments, collection of approval signatures via DocuSign & upload to the VeeDMS system.
  • File quality records according to Vertex records retention policy and procedures.
  • Support internal audit or external audit programs and inspection readiness activities as well as tracking post-inspection readiness.
  • Support GDP operational quality in gathering relevant documentation for disposition on temperature excursions.
  • Support Self-Inspections, preparation, performance, and closure of deficiencies identified.
  • Management of International Quality inbox (intake, triage, and timely responses to QA queries).
  • Support the Responsible Person in the fulfilment of responsibilities associated with the license.

Knowledge and Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree, preferably in life sciences or technical discipline
  • Demonstrated experience with handling compliance issues, resulting from deviations or product defects.
  • Excellent organisational and time management skills and able to demonstrate flexibility and adaptability.
  • Able to prioritise workload, decisive thinker able to work within agreed timescales.
  • Proactive approach and strong critical thinking skills.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with high Level of attention to detail.
  • Utilises available digital tools and systems to enhance QA performance and efficiency.
  • Knowledge of International GDP regulations.
  • Ability to collaborate cross-functionally across all levels of the organization.
  • Ability to drive results.
  • Continuous Process improvement mindset.

Preferred Qualification:

  • Degree in pharmacy, chemistry, medicine, biology, or a related life science
  • GDP & GMP work experience, or relevant comparable background.
  • Experience with processing deviations and CAPA in an electronic QMS tool such as Veeva or equivalent.
  • Knowledge of LATAM Countries Good Distribution Practices and/or Good Manufacturing Practices and the applicable GxP regulations and standards.
  • Fluency in English and Spanish are required
  • Resident in São Paulo, Brazil
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office applications required (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint)

Vertex is partnering with Talent Works to manage their international temporary job openings. If you are successful in your application, you will be employed by Talent Works to work on a temporary assignment at Vertex

title: Analista Tributário Jr (Temporário) | Atacadão
description:
Maior atacadista brasileiro em número de lojas, o Atacadão está presente em mais de 190 cidades espalhadas por todos os estados do Brasil. Com uma história de 60 anos e mais de 60 mil colaboradores, a empresa tem mais de 280 unidades de autosserviço e 33 atacados de entrega, que garantem o abastecimento de comerciantes, transformadores e consumidores finais. Também atua no e-commerce, integrando o canal de vendas online do próprio Atacadão com uma robusta operação de marketplace, com mais de 300 sellers parceiros de atacado. A rede também lidera o Ranking ABAAS, a Associação Brasileira dos Atacadistas de Autosserviço que elenca as redes que mais faturaram em 2021.

GRUPO CARREFOUR BRASIL

Somos hoje o maior empregador privado do País com 150 mil colaboradores e colaboradoras unidos no propósito de contribuir para uma alimentação mais acessível e de qualidade aos brasileiros e brasileiras, colaborando assim com a saúde e o bem-estar de todos e todas.

Unimos o melhor dos dois grupos e somos agora uma empresa mais diversa, com maior capacidade de inovar e causar impacto positivo na sociedade. Além de gerar mais de R$ 100 Bilhões em receitas e liderança no setor de 23% de Market Share.

Estamos investindo fortemente na simplificação e na aceleração digital, pois acreditamos que esse é o caminho para nos transformar e sermos protagonistas da mudança que queremos ver no país.

Trabalhar no Grupo Carrefour Brasil é participar diariamente de tudo isso, em um ambiente que respeita e acolhe as diferenças com muito espaço para crescer e aprender. Somos muitos e queremos ser ainda mais.

E você também pode fazer parte dessa grande jornada. Com você, seremos ainda maiores.

title: IAM Consultant Cybersecurity
description:
Korn Ferry has partnered with our client on their search for IAM Consultant Cybersecurity

The IAM Consultant Cybersecurity plays a critical role in strengthening an Asian financial institution in Brazil information security posture by ensuring that access to systems and data is granted appropriately, securely, and in full alignment with governance policies. This position exists to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets while enabling operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.

To expand its digital ecosystem, average of 300 modules and systems, where 20 systems with their modules will have SOD implemented through a risk matrix, the challenge lies in maintaining robust access controls across a complex and evolving environment. The IAM function is at the heart of this transformation, and this role is essential to bridge operational execution with strategic governance.

The professional in this role will be responsible not only for handling access requests but also for ensuring that each access is justified, traceable, and compliant with internal policies and external audit requirements. This includes working with tools like CyberArk , Varonis , and ServiceNow , while also supporting SoD validations and recertification processes.

The broader challenge for the Information Security team is to shift from a reactive access management model to a proactive, governance-driven approach, where risks are anticipated, processes are standardized, and security is embedded into every access decision. This position is key to driving that shift, bringing technical expertise, process discipline, and a strong sense of ownership to the IAM domain.

Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Be responsible for activities related to Identity, Privileged and Access management, and Segregation Duties through hands-on execution .
  • Lead and execute Privileged Access Management (PAM) operations, with deep hands-on expertise in CyberArk , focusing on vault organization, password rotation, and privileged account governance.
  • Speed in Access Management Response, shifting from a reactive to a proactive stance, following audit findings, continuous monitoring capabilities, and rapid implementation of corrective measures.
  • Support access governance across 300+ systems and modules, ensuring alignment with RBAC and SoD principles , and collaborating with global teams on SoD validation.
  • Operate in a manual and evolving environment , bringing structure, routines, and logic to PAM processes without relying solely on tool implementation and IAM through ServiceNow.
  • Handling urgent requests and stakeholder pressure , while maintaining a firm, technically sound stance.
  • Act as a technical executor , not just a strategist, someone who can “get hands dirty” while applying best practices and security logic in daily operations.
  • Supporting the design of new access flows to ensure traceability and compliance from the outset.
  • Navigating a multicultural environment, with frequent interactions and meetings in English with global teams.

Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of IAM, PAM, SoD, Access Investigation, ITSM and Security/Access Third-Parties companies.
  • Proven experience in PAM administration (CyberArk) , including vault configuration, password rotation policies, account onboarding, and alert handling, beyond tool usage: able to design and implement governance routines and access control logic.
  • Used to work with policies, norms, and procedures that comply with local and regional regulations, such as ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD.
  • Solid knowledge of IAM fundamentals , including RBAC, SoD, access lifecycle, and recertification processes.
  • Experience with log analysis, alert configuration, access investigation (Varonis) , and ServiceNow to access request workflows, incident registration, and audit traceability.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD, and ability to apply them in operational and audit contexts.
  • Knowledge of Bank Processes, regulations, and ensuring compliance with these requirements (Differential).
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in an engineering field (e.g., Computer Engineering, Technology, etc.).
  • Advanced Conversational English, to absorb global directives and participate in international meetings.

Behaviors Skills

  • Security Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for privileged access operations, ensuring secure and compliant execution even beyond direct scope.
  • Proactive Risk Management – Anticipates vulnerabilities in access and credential management, acting before incidents occur.
  • Assertive Communication – Maintains a firm and respectful stance when challenging access requests, navigating conflicts with clarity and professionalism.
  • Operational Discipline & Technical Curiosity – Applies security logic in daily execution, questions configurations, and continuously seeks process improvements.

title: Principal AI Solutions Architect - Travel & Hospitality
description:
This vacancy is open for different locations including Brazil, Uruguay, Colombia and Mexico

Position overview

As an AI Solutions Architect within DataArt’s Travel, Transportation & Hospitality practice, you will bridge the gap between advanced AI tools and real-world business impact. You’ll operate at the intersection of hands-on prototyping, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder education. Your focus: drive measurable client outcomes through AI-enabled efficiencies and new digital experiences.

You will shape how AI is adopted across the travel industry — from intelligent copilots and personalization engines to developer acceleration and operational optimization — by prototyping real solutions, articulating business value, and driving adoption from C-suite to delivery teams.

You will work closely with client account teams (50+ active clients) and DataArt’s AI + Data Lab to identify high-value use cases, prototype rapidly, validate with stakeholders, and showcase scalable solutions that clients can adopt.

Responsabilities

  • Lead ideation and scoping of AI/ML proof of concepts (PoCs) in coordination with client account leaders
  • Rapidly prototype and iterate AI features (chatbots, NLP services, recommender systems, etc.)
  • Direct internal DataArt teams to execute PoCs with clarity, velocity, and alignment
  • Own the "show-and-tell" lifecycle: internal demo → stakeholder validation → external client presentation
  • Develop GenAI applications based on RAG variations, Agentic, hybrid models. Leverage AI in SDLC and advocate for adoption. Develop with hyperscaler AI tools (Azure, GCP, AWS), LLM APIs, vector search, GenAI, Agentic SDKs and Agentic Runtimes (Agent Core, Agent Engine, etc.)
  • Define reusable AI building blocks and Travel-specific agent scaffolds that feed into the Connect AI ecosystem
  • Build working solutions integrated with cloud data platforms like Snowflake and Databricks
  • Embed AI into client-facing products or operations (e.g., personalization, crew ops, service automation)
  • Shape internal best practices for GenAI use in SDLC and Travel product lifecycle — from opportunity discovery to ops telemetry
  • Create AI demo assets: notebooks, dashboards, blog content, or walkthrough videos
  • Run workshops and working sessions with client teams and business leaders
  • Act as a translator and evangelist, helping stakeholders understand responsible AI adoption and potential ROI

Requirements

  • Hands-on experience with AI services from at least one major cloud provider (Azure, AWS, GCP)
  • Demonstrated ability to operate at Director level or above in client engagements, influencing both technical and business stakeholders
  • Experience with designing and implementing RAG based applications
  • Strong background with Snowflake and/or Databricks for data engineering and AI pipelines
  • Proven success leading client-facing PoCs or MVPs from inception to delivery
  • Prior exposure to the travel, transportation, or hospitality sector
  • Ability to translate fuzzy business goals into AI-enabled outcomes, structuring initiatives from ambiguous needs into scoped, testable, and scalable components
  • Fluency in evaluating tradeoffs between open-source LLMs and commercial APIs, and designing cost-efficient, scalable architectures
  • Strong communicator comfortable with both technical teams and business stakeholders
  • USA Visa (client visits will be required)

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of GenAI fine-tuning, vector DBs, or orchestration frameworks (LangChain, Semantic Kernel, etc.)
  • Experience developing internal enablement materials or technical content
  • Awareness of responsible AI practices (e.g., model fairness, explainability, usage boundaries)

What we offer

  • Full remote
  • Paid days off
  • Illness/special days off per year
  • Non-working days on national holidays
  • Internal psychological support service
  • Certification reimbursement (AWS, GCP, Microsoft, etc.)
  • English language classes from the first working day

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Telepatia

Telepatia AI is building an AI Doctor to radically improve healthcare. We recently raised the largest LatAm seed round of $9M, backed by top global investors. Our team comes from Stanford, Microsoft, MD Anderson, Houston Methodist, and Alice, and we’re on a mission to transform how clinical data is captured and used.

Healthcare has two fundamental sources of truth: images and conversations. While most technology has focused on images, 99% of real medical decisions are made through voice. Telepatia is capturing that voice data and turning it into structured, reliable clinical intelligence—unlocking the foundation for an AI-first healthcare system.

We are assembling one of the most talent-dense technical teams in Latin America, with the ambition of building the “Manhattan Project” of AI in healthcare.

Mission of the Role

As an AI Engineer at Telepatia , your mission is to design, build, and deploy AI systems that turn unstructured clinical conversations into structured, reliable medical intelligence. You’ll work across the stack—from backend Python microservices and LLM orchestration to lightweight front-ends and data pipelines—integrating the latest in AI research into production workflows used by doctors daily.

You’ll be part of a small, elite team where each engineer’s output directly impacts the accuracy of our AI systems, the speed of our clinical documentation, and ultimately, patient care across Latin America. This is a role for builders who want to ship fast, work with autonomy, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in applied AI.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and scale Python microservices (FastAPI) that handle real-time inference and structured data processing.
  • Build AI agent pipelines for reasoning, orchestration, and multi-step workflows using tools like LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Develop data pipelines and eval dashboards to monitor, analyze, and improve AI model performance.
  • Collaborate closely with clinicians, product managers, and software engineers to turn ambiguous requests into production-ready AI features—often in less than a day.
  • Integrate models and pipelines into our core Medical Scribe product to enhance automation, reliability, and doctor experience.
  • Contribute to key technical decisions around LLM infrastructure, evaluation, scalability, and deployment.

Must-Haves

  • Strong backend experience in Python , with a focus on microservices (FastAPI preferred).
  • Experience building at the AI application layer : LLM orchestration, agents, and pipelines (LangChain, CrewAI, or similar).
  • Frontend familiarity with React/Tailwind or Flutter for rapid prototyping and data visualization.
  • Experience building and maintaining data pipelines and evaluation dashboards for AI models.
  • High product velocity: you prioritize shipping value quickly over theoretical perfection.
  • Ability to take ambiguous, non-technical requests and turn them into working production features in less than a day.
  • Strong ownership mindset, curiosity, and comfort working in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Background in hard sciences such as Physics or Mathematics .
  • Experience with vector databases , RAG architectures , or model evaluation frameworks .
  • Prior work with healthcare data , EHR systems , or HIPAA/LGPD compliance.
  • Prior startup experience in high-growth or early-stage environments.

title: Solutions Consultant 2
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:

Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.

Who We Are

We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.

As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few! Job Description

Your Career

The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.

Your Impact

Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:

  • Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.

  • Understands Key customer business requirements and has the ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio solutions creating business value for customers.

  • Ability to drive customer adoption of Palo Alto Networks Platform. Building customer relationships by helping customers achieve increased productivity, operational efficiency, security efficacy, and greater flexibility to innovate.

  • Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers

  • Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.

  • Demonstrating strong communication skills, influencing through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, and conducts technical engagements and workshops that are clear and impactful, simplifying complex ideas for various audiences

  • Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.

  • Demonstrates Cross functional leadership driving collaboration and orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy.

  • Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner

  • Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating PANW's leadership in the cybersecurity space

  • Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events

  • Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • 6+ years experience in pre-sales/sales engineering

  • Skilled in at least one of the following Networking, Network Security, Cybersecurity, Private/Public Cloud Security, SOC/Endpoint or SASE.

  • Experience in delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives is preferred

  • Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal

  • Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements

  • Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies

  • Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions

  • Experience in complex sales involving long sales processes with multiple buying centers and multi-product solutions are preferred

  • This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.

Additional Information

The Team

Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.

You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: NGS Technical Sales Specialist | Genomics & Life Sciences (Brazil)
description:
About the Opportunity

Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.

What You’ll Do

Drive Scientific Engagement & Growth

  • Develop and execute a strategic sales plan for MGI’s sequencing and automation portfolio.
  • Identify, qualify, and close new business opportunities within universities, hospitals, research institutes, and biotech companies.
  • Build and maintain strong, collaborative relationships with key opinion leaders and research partners.

Act as a Scientific Partner

  • Provide consultative pre- and post-sales support to ensure customers achieve optimal experimental outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists to deliver a seamless scientific and technical experience.
  • Conduct presentations, workshops, and seminars to demonstrate the impact of MGI technologies on research and clinical applications.

Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay ahead of market trends in genomics, molecular biology, and precision medicine to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent MGI at scientific conferences, trade shows, and regional events as a trusted partner in the life sciences community.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and R&D to align customer feedback with product innovation.

Reporting & Planning

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, and customer records using CRM tools (Salesforce).
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategies to meet and exceed objectives.

Who You Are

  • A scientist with commercial curiosity — passionate about both research and relationship building.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling discussions.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.

What You Bring

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .
  • Hands-on experience with NGS workflows, DNA/RNA sequencing, or lab automation .

Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales goals through consultative, science-driven engagement.

Education & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field required; Master’s or Ph.D. preferred .
  • English: Advanced | Spanish: Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite .
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Brazil.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance .
  • Meal stipend and fitness allowance to support wellbeing.

About MGI

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Security Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $6,000 USD

Along with our partner, we are seeking a security-conscious contract Senior level Software Engineer to help enhance the security posture of their applications. The primary focus of this role is to systematically reduce their attack surface by addressing high-priority security risks. Using Snyk as the primary scanning tool, this engineer will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and remediating dependencies with known exploitable vulnerabilities. The goal is a targeted reduction of risk, not a simple "update-all" approach.

Role & Responsibilities:

The engineer will be responsible for the following:

  • Vulnerability Analysis:  Analyze the results of Snyk scans of their codebases (Ruby, Go, Python, JavaScript).
  • Prioritization: Critically assess Snyk reports to distinguish between theoretical vulnerabilities and those that are genuinely exploitable within the context of their applications.
  • Targeted Remediation:  Plan and execute targeted dependency upgrades or apply patches specifically to fix the prioritized exploitable vulnerabilities, ensuring minimal disruption to the system.
  • Code & Test Validation: Refactor code and update unit/integration tests as necessary to support the upgraded dependencies and validate the fixes.
  • Collaboration & Documentation: Work closely with internal security and engineering teams, participate in code reviews, and clearly document the rationale for each remediation.

Required Skills & Qualifications (Must-Haves):

Candidates must have demonstrable, hands-on experience in the following areas:

  • Security Tooling:  Proven professional experience using  Snyk to identify, prioritize, and manage vulnerabilities in a production environment. Candidate must be able to interpret Snyk's findings, including exploit maturity and reachability.
  • Strong professional experience with all of the following languages:

- Ruby (including Ruby on Rails)

- Go

- Python

- JavaScript

- TypeScript

  • Deep expertise with package managers for each ecosystem (e.g., package.json, Go Modules, Pip/Poetry, NPM/Yarn).
  • Version Control:  Expert-level proficiency with Git.
  • Automated Testing:  A strong commitment to quality with proven experience in writing comprehensive tests.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Haves):

While not mandatory, preference will be given to candidates with experience in:

  • Other Security Tools:  Familiarity with other SAST/SCA tools (e.g., GitHub Advanced Security, Checkmarx, Trivy).
  • CI/CD Integration:  Experience integrating security tools like Snyk into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions).
  • Containerization:  Experience with Docker and container orchestration (e.g., Kubernetes).

Benefits:

  • A fully remote position, allowing for work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to be a part of a mission-driven company that is committed to taking care of its employees.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year
  • 10 paid days for local holidays

Work Schedule : US Eastern Standard Time

*Please note this role is currently for a 3-month project with the potential for a long-term position.

title: Estágio em Importação
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?

Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.

Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.

No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².

Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.

No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.

A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.

Como nosso Estagiário em Custos, você irá:

  • Rotinas administrativas

Requisitos para que possa se juntar ao nós:

  • Residir na região de Jacareí ou São José dos Campos;
  • Ter conhecimento intermediário no pacote office (Principalmente Excel).
  • Conhecimento com sistemas SAP - Diferencial

Você usufruirá dos seguintes benefícios:

  • Transporte fretado

1. Gestão de Cronograma e Prazos (Foco Central)

2. Facilitação e Intermediação Interna

  • Ponto Focal Engenharia-Compras: Atuar como o elo de comunicação primário entre a Engenharia (Gestão de Projetos) e o Departamento de Compras, traduzindo as necessidades técnicas em requisitos de compra claros e vice-versa.

  • Qualificação de Fornecedores: Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a qualificação de fornecedores estratégicos para projetos, em conjunto com o time de Sourcing e Qualidade.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação: Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Conhecimento robusto do processo de compras ( Sourcing e Procurement ), e capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos/especificações.

We’re hiring a Lead Analyst / Content Team Lead to manage and mentor a team of analysts creating business-focused content to improve AI models with no AI experience required. You’ll combine leadership, quality oversight, and subject expertise in MBA-relevant domains to ensure outputs are accurate, logically sound, and aligned with project goals. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys people management, operational excellence, and shaping high-quality analytical content.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and mentor a team of Business Analysts/Content Specialists.
  • Allocate tasks, oversee workflows, and ensure timely, high-quality delivery.
  • Conduct QA reviews, refine processes, and improve team efficiency.
  • Provide performance feedback, training, and career development.
  • Act as the primary stakeholder contact, sharing regular project updates.
  • Guide creation of case studies, scenarios, and structured business content (finance, policy, e-commerce, etc.).

What We’re Looking For:

  • 2+ years of team management experience.
  • 3–6 years in business analysis, consulting, content, or domain-focused projects.
  • Strong analytical, logical, and communication skills.
  • Proficiency in structured file formats (TSV, JSON, HTML, XML, Markdown).
  • No AI experience required
  • Bonus: prior work on LLM performance data, case study writing, or academic/research content.
  • Full-time commitment (40 hrs/week); immediate joiners preferred.

Why Join Us:

  • Competitive pay and flexible remote work.
  • Lead a team working on cutting-edge AI projects.
  • Exposure to advanced LLMs and how they’re trained.
  • Freelance perks: autonomy, flexibility, and global collaboration.
  • Potential for contract extension.

Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration: 1 month.

Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent an automated challenge (60 mins).
  • Once you clear the challenge, we will reach out to you for an interview.
  • Once you clear the interview, you are ready to go!

About Turing:

Turing, based in San Francisco, is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises. We advance cutting-edge research with high-quality data, training pipelines, and top AI talent across coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents. We also help enterprises turn AI from proof-of-concept into proprietary systems that deliver reliable performance, measurable impact, and real results on the P&L.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Especialista em Engenharia de Qualidade de Software
description:
O Especialista em Engenharia de Qualidade de Software atua de forma estratégica para garantir a aplicação eficaz dos processos e ferramentas definidas pelo COE, assegurando governança e rastreabilidade das informações de teste. Seu principal propósito é elevar a maturidade em qualidade de software na organização, promovendo a cultura de qualidade e disseminando práticas modernas de Quality Engineering entre os times ágeis.

Escopo e Impacto

  • Atua em projetos corporativos de médio a grande porte, com impacto direto na eficiência operacional e na confiabilidade dos produtos digitais;
  • Contribui na padronização de práticas e frameworks de testes dentro da organização, garantindo alinhamento com o COE;
  • Interage com times multifuncionais (desenvolvedores, analistas de negócio, arquitetos e gestores de produto) para assegurar qualidade contínua desde as fases iniciais do desenvolvimento;
  • Atua com supervisão moderada, sendo responsável por decisões técnicas dentro do escopo de testes;
  • Complexidade Alta – exige integração de múltiplas disciplinas (automação, performance, governança e inovação tecnológica);
  • Atua como referência técnica em Quality Engineering, contribuindo para decisões estratégicas da área.

Responsabilidades Principais

  1. Planejar e executar estratégias de testes funcionais e não funcionais , alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e diretrizes do COE;
  2. Implementar e otimizar pipelines de automação de testes , garantindo cobertura e eficiência em APIs, Web e Mobile;
  3. Aplicar técnicas de GenAI em testes de software , buscando inovação e ganho de produtividade;
  4. Promover a cultura de Quality Engineering , atuando como multiplicador de boas práticas e mentor técnico nos times ágeis;
  5. Definir e acompanhar indicadores de qualidade (KPIs) e métricas de maturidade de testes;
  6. Garantir rastreabilidade e governança dos artefatos de teste , utilizando ferramentas corporativas (ex: Octane, Jira, Test Link, etc);
  7. Conduzir análises de performance, stress e usabilidade , recomendando melhorias contínuas nos produtos.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas da Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Atuação comprovada em testes de software, preferencialmente como automatizador ou engenheiro de qualidade;
  • Experiência em Scrum e Waterfall;
  • Conhecimento em Selenium, Appium, Rest Assured, entre outros frameworks;
  • Domínio de lógica de programação e bancos de dados relacionais (SQL Server, Oracle, etc);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de teste e gestão (ex: TDM, Octane, Jira, UFT Mobile, Solman, Test Link);
  • Conhecimento sólido em performance, stress e usabilidade;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações de inteligência artificial generativa no contexto de testes.

Benefícios

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Previdência Privada;
  • Gympass;
  • PLR;
  • Vale Transporte;
  • Estacionamento;
  • Restaurante no local.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
Sobre a Online Garantias

A Online Garantias é uma empresa líder em soluções de garantias contratuais e judiciais, oferecendo serviços inovadores e ágeis para clientes de diversos segmentos. Nosso foco é conectar pessoas e empresas a soluções de garantias que tragam segurança financeira e eficiência nos processos, tudo de forma digital e prática.

Descrição da Vaga

Buscamos um(a) Vendedor(a) Sênior com sólida experiência em vendas de produtos financeiros ou bancários. Conhecimento prévio no ramo de seguros ou garantias é um diferencial. A principal responsabilidade é prospectar novos clientes e estabelecer relacionamentos, com ênfase em contatos por telefone, reuniões virtuais e, ocasionalmente, visitas presenciais. Após criar o rapport com potenciais clientes, o(a) profissional irá repassar essas contas para a equipe interna de produtores comerciais que conduzirão as negociações seguintes.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Identificar e prospectar ativamente potenciais clientes por meio de ligações “frias”, redes de contato e outras estratégias de prospecção.
  • Realizar demonstrações e apresentações sobre os serviços de garantias, destacando benefícios e diferenciais competitivos.
  • Manter relacionamentos sólidos com prospects, criando confiança e construindo reputação de especialista em garantias financeiras.
  • Organizar e conduzir reuniões (virtuais e/ou presenciais), bem como realizar follow-ups constantes até o momento de repassar o cliente para os produtores internos.
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado em garantias e produtos financeiros, identificando oportunidades para alavancar as vendas.
  • Cumprir ou superar metas de vendas e indicadores de desempenho definidos pela empresa.

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida em vendas de produtos financeiros/bancários; conhecimento em seguros ou garantias será considerado um diferencial.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e negociação, com capacidade de construir rapport rapidamente por telefone e em reuniões presenciais.
  • Foco em resultados, organização e disciplina para gerenciar o pipeline de vendas.
  • Mentalidade voltada para prospecção ativa e abertura de novos negócios.
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em São José dos Campos (SP) e para eventuais visitas externas.
  • Carisma e habilidade de se relacionar com pessoas de diferentes perfis, demonstrando empatia e confiança no contato inicial.
  • Graduação em Administração, Marketing, Economia ou áreas correlatas (desejável).

O que Oferecemos

  • Salário compatível com o mercado e política de comissão atrativa.
  • Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, com foco em crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.
  • Oportunidade de atuar em uma empresa em franca expansão, com carteira de clientes diversificada.
  • Treinamentos e suporte interno para aprimorar conhecimentos sobre garantias e seguros.

---

About Online Garantias

Online Garantias is a leading company in contractual and judicial guarantee solutions, offering agile and innovative services to clients across various sectors. We focus on delivering efficient and digital financial security solutions, ensuring a streamlined and reliable experience for our customers.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Sales Executive with proven experience in selling financial or banking products. Prior knowledge in insurance or guarantees is a plus. The main responsibility is to prospect new clients and build relationships, emphasizing phone outreach, virtual meetings, and occasional on-site visits. Once a strong rapport is established, the Senior Sales Executive will pass qualified clients on to the in-house sales producers who will continue negotiations.

Key Responsibilities

  • Actively identify and prospect potential clients through cold calls, networking, and other lead generation strategies.
  • Deliver presentations highlighting the benefits and competitive advantages of our guarantee solutions.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with prospects, positioning yourself as a trusted expert in financial guarantees.
  • Organize and lead virtual or in-person meetings, performing regular follow-ups until handing over clients to internal producers.
  • Stay updated on market trends in guarantees and financial products to uncover opportunities and drive sales.
  • Meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs set by the company.
